q: Time is measured in years, months, days, hours, minutes and seconds, but the SI unit for time is the ____.
e: The second is the fundamental SI base unit for measuring time.

q: Most common modern clocks and watches depend on the vibration of ____ to keep time accurately.
e: Quartz crystals vibrate at a highly stable frequency when an electric current is applied.

q: The energy to keep these crystals vibrating comes from a ____.
e: A battery provides the necessary electrical energy for the quartz oscillator.

q: A stopwatch (or) a stop clock can be chosen to measure the time to an accuracy of a ____.
e: Analog stopwatches typically offer precision to the nearest tenth of a second.

q: Digital stopwatches can measure up to ____.
e: Digital stopwatches provide higher resolution, measuring down to one hundredth of a second.
